mess.en: My brother's room is always a mess.
mess.zh: 我弟弟的房间总是很乱。

miracle.en: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?
miracle.zh: 我能等奇迹发生，是不是？

magician.en: I have a friend whose father is a magician.
magician.zh: 我有一个父亲是魔术师的朋友。

major.en: What do you plan to major in at college?
major.zh: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？

marry.en: I told him, once and for all, that I would not marry him.
marry.zh: 我告诉他，我永远不会嫁给他。

modest.en: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
modest.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖后，她仍谦虚如昔。

mad.en: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
mad.zh: 当她看到妈妈没在生她的气，她的双眼因为幸福而闪烁了。

mathematics.en: Mathematics is an easy subject for me.
mathematics.zh: 数学对我来说是一个容易的科目。

movie.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
movie.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

mirror.en: How many times a day do you look at yourself in the mirror?

missing.en: Tom thinks I'm missing this great opportunity.
missing.zh: 汤姆觉得我要错过这大好机会了。

might.en: Tom said he thought he might be the only one who had to do that.
might.zh: 汤姆说他以为需要做那件事的就只有他一个。

mammal.en: A dolphin is a kind of mammal.

married.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
married.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。

mercury.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
mercury.zh: 水星是我们的太阳系中最小的行星。

mere.en: You're no longer a mere child.
mere.zh: 你不再只是一个孩子了。

memory.en: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.

mayor.en: "What do you think of the election for mayor?" "I don't know."
mayor.zh: “你对市长选举怎么看？”“我不知道。”

mission.en: Who picked you for this mission?

musician.en: In her opinion, he is the best musician she has ever seen.
musician.zh: 她认为他是她所见过最好的音乐家。

mud.en: He scraped the mud off his boots.

minister.en: He made his way to the minister.

mood.en: I hope Tom is in a good mood tomorrow.
mood.zh: 我希望汤姆明天心情愉快。

metal.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
metal.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

means.en: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
means.zh: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

mouse.en: Should I buy a wireless mouse?
mouse.zh: 要不要买个无线鼠标呢？

melt.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
melt.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。

monkey.en: I'm not talking to you. I'm talking to the monkey.
monkey.zh: 我不是在跟你说话，我在跟猴子说话。

marriage.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
marriage.zh: 婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。

mix.en: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.
mix.zh: 我不喜欢把生意和快乐混在一起。

mixture.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.

makeup.en: Tom doesn't like women who wear too much makeup.
makeup.zh: 汤姆不喜欢妆化太浓的女人。

message.en: "Shall I take a message?" "No, thank you."
message.zh: “需要我为您留个口信儿吗？”“不用了，谢谢。”

master.en: It's quite difficult to master French in 2 or 3 years.

mobile.en: I need to charge my mobile phone.

mosquito.en: Minnesota's state bird is the mosquito.
mosquito.zh: 明尼苏达州的官方鸟就是蚊子。

merely.en: He said it merely as a joke.
merely.zh: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。

model.en: I'd like to try out this new model before I buy it.
model.zh: 我想在买之前先试试这个新机型。

method.en: This method is sure to work.

mile.en: A mile is equal to about 1,600 meters.

merry.en: I wish you a Merry Christmas.

masterpiece.en: I think that Liszt's "Forgotten Waltz No.3" is a hidden masterpiece.
masterpiece.zh: 我觉得李斯特的《被遗忘的圆舞曲第三首》是个被埋没的名曲。

monk.en: Tom has decided to become a monk.

moist.en: Winds from the sea are moist.
moist.zh: 从海洋吹来的风感觉湿漉漉的。

medical.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.

millionaire.en: I'm going to be a millionaire.
millionaire.zh: 我就要成为百万富翁了。

meaningful.en: She gave me a meaningful look.
meaningful.zh: 她意味深长地看了我一眼。

museum.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
museum.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

magazine.en: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
magazine.zh: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

mild.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
mild.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

moss.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

mislead.en: I didn't want to mislead anyone.

mat.en: Entering the house, I tripped over the mat.
mat.zh: 进家门后，我被垫子绊倒了。

mortal.en: We know that all men are mortal.
mortal.zh: 我们知道人皆难免一死。

marathon.en: One hundred and fifty people entered the marathon race.

manage.en: You should be able to manage it.

mountainous.zh: 亚美尼亚是一个多山的国家。

musical.en: Do you play a musical instrument?

marsh.en: Lots of herons live in the marsh.
marsh.zh: 许多苍鹭在沼泽地中生活。

mass.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
mass.zh: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。

maple.en: Could you pass me the maple syrup?

monthly.en: How much is your monthly gas bill?
monthly.zh: 你每个月的瓦斯费多少钱？

mechanic.zh: 这名技师组装了这台引擎。

microwave.en: Tom doesn't have a microwave oven.

main.en: The main problem with Tom is that he has no sense of humor.
main.zh: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

meditate.en: He used to meditate in the morning.
meditate.zh: 他过去时常在早上的时候冥想。

manual.en: Can you drive a manual transmission?

military.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.
military.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。

meadow.en: Cows are eating grass in the meadow.

melon.en: Cut the melon into six equal pieces.

mature.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
mature.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

mutual.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
mutual.zh: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。

material.en: She is collecting material for a book.

microphone.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
microphone.zh: 刚才我的麦克风没起作用，不知道为什么。

mute.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and mute.
mute.zh: 海伦·凯勒眼盲、耳聋并且不能说话。

membership.en: I applied for membership in the association.

maintain.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
maintain.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

mysterious.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
mysterious.zh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

measure.en: There are several ways to measure speed.

minimum.en: What's the minimum wage in your country?
minimum.zh: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？

mist.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
mist.zh: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。

mansion.en: Compared to our house, yours is a mansion.
mansion.zh: 跟我们的房子比，你的就是个豪宅。

mark.en: Mark the words that you cannot understand.

murmur.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

monster.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.
monster.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。

magnetism.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.

manuscript.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
manuscript.zh: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。

mainly.en: That company deals mainly in imported goods.
mainly.zh: 这公司主要做进口货物的生意。

manufacture.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

manner.en: There is nothing worse than doing something in a half-hearted manner.
manner.zh: 没有什么比做事缺乏热情更糟。

marine.en: Tom is studying to become a marine biologist.
marine.zh: 汤姆为了当海洋生物学家学习。

moderate.en: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
moderate.zh: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。

monopoly.en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
monopoly.zh: 大富翁是一个家庭玩的热门游戏。

majority.en: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
majority.zh: 法案以10票微弱多数通过。

motel.en: The motel can accommodate as many as 400 guests.
motel.zh: 汽车旅馆可以接待多达400名客人。

mask.en: He wore a mask so that no one could recognize him.
mask.zh: 他戴著面具以至于没有人认出他。

massive.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
massive.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

mercy.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
mercy.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。

male.en: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
male.zh: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。

microscope.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
microscope.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
